structure.note: Three classes: Class B carries ten votes per share, Class A one vote and Class C none. The FY2025 10-K says Larry Page and Sergey Brin together beneficially owned about 89.3% of Class B, about 52.7% of the voting power, at December 31, 2025. The 2026 proxy gives Page 27.4% and Brin 25.3% of total voting power. No single person holds a majority, so 'controlled' is false, but the two co-founders together do.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Documents read on sec.gov: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001652044-26-000018, filed February 5, 2026) and 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001308179-26-000342, filed April 24, 2026). OWNERSHIP: the proxy table covers only the voting classes (A and B); 'Non-voting Class C capital stock is not included in the table.' Page's 389,051,160 Class B shares are 46.5% of Class B and 27.4% of total voting power at April 6, 2026. The economic share is therefore given only as leader.derived, computed from his Class B shares over all three classes outstanding on the April 6, 2026 record date, both taken from the proxy. It counts Class B only, so it is a floor: if Page holds any Class C, which neither filing discloses, his economic stake is higher. LARGEST HOLDERS left empty on purpose: the proxy's only other 5% holder is BlackRock, stated as 356,934,964 Class A shares = 6.1% of Class A (13G/A filed February 12, 2024) with Class C excluded, and Sergey Brin's 358,939,978 Class B shares are 42.9% of Class B (25.3% of voting power); none is a share of all shares outstanding, and recomputing them is not allowed. Vanguard is no longer listed: the proxy says that on March 26, 2026 it amended its Schedule 13G/A to disclose that, as of January 12, 2026, after an internal realignment, it no longer has beneficial ownership of the Class A shares it previously reported. STOCK COMP: the cash-flow line ($24,953 million). DIVIDENDS: the 10-K says payments to holders of Class A, Class B and Class C were $4.8 billion, $703 million and $4.5 billion in 2025. GEOGRAPHY: copied as reported except the hedging line, a loss of $127 million that the schema cannot hold as a negative segment, so the four regions sum to 402.96 against the stated total of 402.84 (402,836 million); EMEA = Europe, Middle East and Africa, APAC = Asia-Pacific, Other Americas = Canada and Latin America. No broad employee stock purchase plan is described, so plan is null. Structure note source (FY2025 10-K, Item 1A): 'As of December 31, 2025, Larry Page and Sergey Brin beneficially owned approximately 89.3% of our outstanding Class B stock, which represented approximately 52.7% of the voting power of our outstanding common stock.'
